Shameless: the ads that align with each funnel, six months

Meta only · Mar 16 to Sep 14 2026 (26 weeks) · source: ejam-dwh cro_dashboard_ads, brand SHA, channel facebook, grouped by the page the ad sent people to · every ad code opens the creative, every page name opens the live page · built Sep 16 2026

Funnels · Leaderboard · Biggest spenders · Match mechanisms · Fiber First · Variety Pack (it2) · GLP-1 (old URL) · GLP-1 (real page) · Target · Swap · Fiber goals (NYNM) · Mini Bites

How to read this

  1. Rows are the page the visitor landed on. Fiber First is served by four build labels with identical HTML, so they are one row; /glp-1/ ran its own build until Jun 20 and the Fiber First HTML after, so it gets its own row with that caveat. Ads whose name carries no URL (Trybe creator posts, boosted posts, audience-named Advantage+ ads) are placed by their build label; they are tagged in the tables.
  2. Match asks one question: does the page confirm what the ad promises on its first screen? Aligned the page repeats the ad's promise. Partial the offer carries through but the message does not (a fiber fact on the deal page, a haul on the flavors page). Does not belong the page ignores or contradicts the ad. Unclassified no transcript, headline or angle token to judge from. Every ad over $3,000 was reviewed by hand (150 ads); the rest were classified by rules over the transcript, headline and the AI tag breakdown, and the tables say which. Pages are judged as they render today. The pre-Jun-20 /glp-1/ build cannot be fetched, so spring GLP-1 ads are judged against the build label (Free-Gifts-GLP-1), assumed to be the GLP-1 page.
  3. Contribution = revenue + upsell − COGS − merchant fees − ad spend. CM % = contribution ÷ revenue. Goal Pacing definitions, after ad spend, first-order only, so negative is normal here (subscriptions pay back on rebills). Compare rows against each other, not against zero.
  4. Add to cart is the click from the page into checkout. $ / LP view is what a visitor costs. A visit costs about the same on every page; the cart rate is what moves CPA, and the cart rate is where match shows up.

Match mechanisms

Offer echoThe ad promises the deal the page opens with (46% off, free gifts, sale ends). The visitor arrives to confirm, not to be convinced. Every top-CM ad on Fiber First for six months is one of these.SH-13396-1, SH-11606-10, SH-15191-5, SH-16975-2, SH-12937-7, FINAL CLEARANCE statics
Page quoteThe ad copy is the page headline. Zero re-orientation on landing; 64 to 67% cart.SH-18979-1, SH-18969 on Mini Bites
Retail proof loopAd says "at Target", page says "your next Target run". Three statics, 34 to 36% cart, 1.13 to 1.15 ROAS, every month for six months.SH-13376-6, -9, -10
Problem, then the page that answers itA constipation-on-GLP-1 ad on the page whose first reason is digestion on a GLP-1. The only ad over $20k above breakeven in the window.SH-13107-6 on /glp-2/
Amazon contradictionThe ad sells the Amazon bestseller; the page says "flavors you won't find on Amazon". Cheapest clicks in the account, 13 to 18% cart, $140k across two pages.SH-17273-4, SH-17273-9, SH-15957-7
Mindset switchA label-reader or permission ad (880 calories, whole bag guilt-free, 3 grams) lands on a gift-box page. Cheap traffic that came for a fact, asked to buy a bundle. $290k at 27 to 29% cart.SH-16975-3, AUD_INT_Fitness_CleanEating, AUD_LAL1 3-grams
Ghost page/glp-1/ has served the Fiber First HTML since Jun 20. Problem-led GLP-1 ads sent there have nothing to land on; the real GLP-1 page is /glp-2/.SH-14765-7, SH-14498-8 since Jun 20

Open the imageFacebook post
InsightOn this page the match is the offer, and the offer needs a clock. The three best videos of the six months all state the deal and a deadline (final bow, ends tonight, ends this weekend) and cart at 48 to 55%. The evergreen offer cuts (box haul, 12 bags) cart at 38 to 45% with no deadline. The fact-led cuts (880 calories, whole bag, 3 grams) cart at 27 to 29% and lost $150k between them.
What to doRun a real sale calendar and brief deadline cuts against it (SH-13396-1 and SH-15191-5 are the templates). Retire SH-16180-1 or cut a new count. Move the 880-calorie and whole-bag cuts to Swap, where the first screen answers their question. Keep SH-16975-2 and SH-12937-7 as the evergreen pair.

Shameless Snacks · best creatives by funnel, six months, Sep 16 2026. Figures from ejam-dwh cro_dashboard_ads, Mar 16 to Sep 14 2026, brand SHA, channel facebook, ads grouped by the URL in the ad name (ads without a URL placed by lp_variant); ad tables show ads with $1,000+ on that page, page totals include all spend. Contribution = revenue + upsell − COGS − merchant fees − ad spend (agency fees null for the window; refunds excluded, about 2% of revenue). CM % = contribution ÷ (revenue + upsell). Add to cart = click from the landing page into checkout. Page promises fetched from the live URLs on Sep 16 2026. Ad links open the creative through the eJam asset proxy. Ads are pinned to one page by their URL, so every page-versus-page number carries that page's creative mix. The CRO dashboard attributes about 9% more spend than the creative dashboard for the same window; numbers here are the CRO dashboard's own.
